business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Intermediary for Regulated Startup Equity Offerings

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (Unitary National Jurisdiction; no separate sub-state corporate registry)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European tradition, with statutory commercial law governed by the Código de Comercio and Ley 1258 de 2008 for the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (investment chapter, in force May 15, 2012)
Colombia–Canada Free Trade Agreement (in force August 15, 2011)
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement (trade and investment provisions, provisionally applied since August 1, 2013)
Colombia–United Kingdom Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2012)
Colombia–Spain Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2008)
Colombia–Switzerland Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2012)
Colombia–South Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2014)
Colombia–Mexico Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2010)
Colombia–Chile Double Taxation Agreement (in force since 2007)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006 and Ley 1762 de 2015) creating the UIAF and the mandatory anti-money laundering / counter-terrorist financing reporting system; Ley 2010 de 2019, Artículo 3, Decreto 830 de 2020 and DIAN Resolución 000018 de 2021 (mandatory beneficial-owner identification and reporting regime); Decreto 1067 de 2015 (AML/CFT single regulatory decree for the non-financial sector); Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, Circular Básica Jurídica, Parte I, Título IV, as updated (SARLAFT); Decreto 1357 de 2018, as amended, and SFC instructions on collaborative-finance platforms (equity crowdfunding); Código de Comercio and Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. corporate law).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of existence and legal representation of each foreign corporate shareholder, issued by the competent registry in the country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry / Chamber of Commerce of the shareholder's jurisdiction of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia has been a party to the 1961 Hague Convention since December 8, 2001; documents issued in non-Hague jurisdictions require Colombian consular legalization)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special power of attorney (poder especial) granted by each foreign shareholder in favor of the Colombian legal representative or incorporators
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian Consular Legalization, followed by Spanish translation and protocolización before a Colombian Notaría when required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of passports and identification documents of all UBOs, legal representatives and directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public / competent authority of the document holder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization required only when relying on certified notarial copies issued abroad

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn declaration of lawful origin of funds (declaración juramentada de origen lícito de fondos) executed by each UBO before a Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Domestic notarization only; no apostille required (Colombian notarial act)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference / source-of-funds confirmation for each UBO and substantial foreign shareholder (as part of SFC know-your-investor diligence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank or financial institution of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Colombian consular legalization when issued outside Colombia; otherwise accepted as an original document with sworn Spanish translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and continuous screening of each UBO, shareholder, director and legal representative against (i) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Sectoral Sanctions lists; (ii) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list; (iii) Colombian domestic lists maintained by UIAF, Fiscalía General de la Nación and national security authorities; (iv) Interpol Red Notices; and (v) commercial and governmental Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) databases. The screening protocol must be documented in writing and retained for at least five years; any positive hit triggers immediate Suspicious Transaction Reporting (ROS) to UIAF and enhanced due diligence prior to the SFC license filing under SARLAFT.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) — https://www.rues.org.co; name searches and the 'certificado de homonimia' (negative name certificate) are obtained through the Chamber of Commerce of the intended registered office, e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (https://www.ccb.org.co) online platform.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in a form that is readably transliterable into Spanish; when using a foreign word or expression, the incorporator must provide its Spanish translation or define its meaning in the articles of association. The name may contain Spanish letters, accents and typographic marks regulated by the Chambers of Commerce; foreign-alphabet names must be transliterated to Latin characters. A distinctive token may be followed by 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Banco Central / Banca (requires prior SFC authorization)
Seguros / Reaseguros / Compañía de Seguros (requires prior SFC authorization)
Valores / Bolsa / Comisionista de Bolsa / Intermediario de Valores (requires prior SFC authorization)
Fondo / Administradora de Fondos / Fondo de Inversión (requires prior SFC authorization)
Crowdfunding / Financiación Colaborativa as a standalone descriptor (subject to SFC scrutiny for regulated activity)
Ministerio / Nacional / Presidencia / República / Gobernación / Alcaldía / Estado / Distrito (sovereign or governmental tokens; require competent ministerial or governmental authorization)
Policía / Ejército / Fuerza Aérea / Fiscalía / Corte / Tribunal / Procuraduría (official security or judicial bodies; prohibited without authorization)
Universidad / Colegio / Institución Educativa (require Ministry of Education authorization)
Corporación / Cooperativa / Asociación Mutual (require Superintendencia de Economía Solidaria or other prior authorization when denoting special legal forms)
Cruz Roja / UNICEF / Interpol (internationally protected names; prohibited)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The 'certificado de homonimia' is valid for 30 calendar days; at the discretion of the Chamber of Commerce, a single extension of an additional 30 days may be obtained upon payment of the extension fee. If the proposed name is rejected, the incorporator may file a 'recurso de reposición' before the same Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days of notification under Ley 1437 de 2011 (Código de Procedimiento Administrativo y de lo Contencioso Administrativo – CPACA), followed by a 'recurso de apelación' to the Superintendencia de Sociedades. The administrative decision may ultimately be challenged before the Contencioso Administrativo courts. As a practical alternative, an amended name can be reserved immediately to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the sole operating office for the regulated equity crowdfunding portal. A virtual or serviced office may support pre-incorporation correspondence and the interim registered domicile, but the SFC authorization for a crowdfunding portal requires a permanent physical office in Colombia equipped with the administrative, technological, data-privacy and records infrastructure that the SFC may inspect. The official registered address at the Chamber of Commerce must be a real place where business is conducted and where legal documents may be personally delivered.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High — quantified likelihood of an unannounced physical inspection by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia during the license evaluation stage and the first 12 months of operations is estimated at 60–80% for novel high-risk fintech platforms; additional joint inspections may occur with DIAN for tax, UBO and electronic invoicing compliance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability certificate (certificado de homonimia) — one search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory minor tariff: approx. 15,000–20,000 COP under the current CCB official fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the S.A.S. articles of association (estatutos sociales), UBO clauses and corporate governance documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 1,000–2,500 for SAS incorporation and pre-licensing counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of foreign documents (per document block)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 60–150 per document depending on volume and urgency

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille issuance for each foreign-origin document (up to 3 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority of the issuing jurisdiction (e.g., U.S. Secretary of State or equivalent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official Hague Apostille tariff: USD 15–30 per document (varies by issuing state)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the incorporation private deed and UBO sworn fund-origin declarations before a Colombian notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaría Pública del Círculo de Bogotá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff: approx. 80,000–250,000 COP including notarial copies

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration: merchant registration (matrícula mercantil) and SAS registration (inscripción del acta)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff computed on registered capital (approx. 1.5 per mille of capital plus fixed registration base fee); estimate for zero-to-minimal paid-in capital: 120,000–350,000 COP

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO report (declaración de beneficiario final) preparation, certification and annual filing with DIAN / Superintendencia de Sociedades
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External public accountant registered before the Junta Central de Contadores
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 150–400 per annual UBO compliance cycle (SEP report and DIAN exogenous information)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary SARLAFT / AML-CFT compliance program (policies, risk classification matrix, onboarding and transaction monitoring manual) developed for the SFC license application
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML/CFT compliance consultant or specialized law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 2,000–4,500 for a high-risk crowdfunding entity pre-licensing package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening database subscription (first year, covering UBOs, directors and future investors)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial KYC/AML data provider (e.g., World-Check / LexisNexis, Dow Jones, or local provider)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Vendor list price: USD 250–1,200 per year depending on entity risk profile

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office address (serviced office) — three-month reservation during pre-incorporation and license filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: USD 100–250 per month for a professional virtual-plus-meeting office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SFC regulatory study and filing fee for the authorization of the equity crowdfunding platform (non-refundable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under SFC official tariff schedule (approx. 2,400,000–2,700,000 COP)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 5, 11, 13, 22, and 40; Colombia Código de Comercio Arts. 110, 111, 354; Decreto 1074 de 2015 (RUES); Decreto 1357 de 2018 (financiamiento colaborativo).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (acting through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social - RUES) under the general surveillance of the Superintendencia de Sociedades.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento privado de constitución (private incorporation instrument) registered in RUES, bearing the expression 'constituida como Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada'; a public deed is required only if the initial contributions include real estate.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital for an S.A.S. Capital is defined by the shareholders in the by-laws; cash contributions may be paid within two years, while non-cash contributions must be delivered immediately. Any crowdfunding portal must maintain an SFC-required own capital and place investor funds in a regulated escrow/trust account before operations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: the capital subscription schedule contained in the incorporation document is hereby approved, and the subscribed shares are validly issued to the shareholders for the contributions agreed therein. RESOLVED FURTHER: the registered office is adopted at the address stated in the by-laws and shall constitute the Company's legal seat for Chamber, tax, and supervisory purposes. RESOLVED FURTHER: the following officers are appointed: [Name] as Legal Representative and Chief Executive Officer; [Name] as Corporate Secretary and Compliance Officer. The Legal Representative is empowered to register the company with the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN, UIAF, and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, to open bank and escrow accounts, and to execute all documents necessary for the equity crowdfunding authorization.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-validation and reservation of the company name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social via RUES online portal (www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES name consultation module and request a reserva de nombre for the S.A.S. The object clause must expressly include digital intermediation of regulated equity offerings (ISIC 6499). Submit at least two alternative names.
required_dossiers: Completed RUES name consultation and reservation form
Citizenship cards or valid identification of each subscribing shareholder
Power of attorney (if a legal representative files on behalf of a shareholder)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for identity or similarity, file a revised application with a different corporate denomination or submit a written objection to the Cámara de Comercio using trademark and trade-name priority evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the private incorporation contract and by-laws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Shareholders meeting under the auspices of an authorised attorney and, if notarial form is chosen, a Colombian Notaría
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish complying with Ley 1258 de 2008 Art. 5. The document must state the identification of shareholders, corporate purpose, capital, share classes, registered office, directors, and legal representation clauses. Each shareholder signs or an attorney certifies the authenticity of signatures. Include an express clause authorizing application for the SFC crowdfunding licence.
required_dossiers: Pre-reserved name certificate
Identification documents and tax numbers of all shareholders
Capital contribution schedule and proof of in-kind contribution valuation, if any
Anti-money-laundering/KYC statements identifying ultimate beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the constitution document is defective, prepare and file a corrective acta or rectification with the same Chamber office; notarial or legalisation defects are cured by re-signature or by an initial notarial deed amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Merchant and company registration with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social through RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed incorporation document with the Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil and pay the variable inscription tariff. After verification, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal. The certificate is the operative corporate existence document for all banks, regulators, and administrative bodies.
required_dossiers: Signed private incorporation contract
Formulario de Registro Único Empresarial (RUES)
Identification documents of the legal representative
Reservation certificate issued under step 1
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct or supplement the information requested by the registrar within the Chamber's stated term; if the entry is delayed or queried, request the correction via the RUES 'error report' and, if necessary, petition the Superintendencia de Sociedades.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax identification (NIT) and RUT registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — Municipality registration and MUISCA online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After Chamber registration, file the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) in MUISCA with the NIT already generated by the Chamber integration. Select the CIIU 6499 activity and the ordinary income-tax regime. Request authorisation to issue electronic invoice and appoint the fiscal/electronic invoicing provider. Update the Domicilio Fiscal to match the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Constitución Deed or private document
Identification and NIT of the legal representative
Power of attorney for tax agent, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT electronic pre-registration is rejected, correct data entry at a DIAN service point and re-enter; objections to tax-status classification may be answered by letter through the same portal with supporting statutory authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ultimate beneficial owner registration and officer appointment filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RUES / Superintendencia de Sociedades and UIAF
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Formulario de Beneficiario Final with RUES, identifying natural persons holding or controlling more than 5% of shares or control. Record the appointment of the Legal Representative, Corporate Secretary, and Compliance Officer. Adopt the mandatory anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing policies before commencing crowdfunding activities.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Beneficial owner disclosure form and KYC file
Board resolution appointing officers
AML/CFT compliance policy draft
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the social register reports incongruences, amend the by-laws or acta and resubmit; apostilled identification of non-resident shareholders may be required, and any rejection can be cured with legalisation or sworn translation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of corporate bank accounts and investor escrow/trust arrangement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorised commercial bank and regulated Sociedad Fiduciaria under SFC supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Provide the corporate registry certificate and NIT to a commercial bank to open the operating account and a separate client-money escrow account. Coordinate with a licensed fiduciary company to hold investor funds in trust, segregated from company assets, because equity crowdfunding requires escrow before transfer to issuers. Deposited capital must be credited to a Colombian financial institution and comply with circulars on management of third-party resources.
required_dossiers: Corporate registry certificate
NIT/RUT certificate
Legal representative identification
Corporate KYC forms and shareholding structure
Escrow agreement for crowdfunding investors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes enhanced due diligence or account restrictions, supply the SFC pre-authorisation letter, financial statements, and a sworn declaration of non-political-exposed-person status; if the bank still refuses, select another supervised institution and re-file the documentation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for authorisation as an equity crowdfunding portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) — Autorizaciones Fintech/Crowdfunding Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File with the SFC the application to operate as a Plataforma de Financiamiento Colaborativo under Decreto 1357 of 2018. Submit the corporate charter, business plan, technological and cybersecurity plan, investor protection rules, AML/CFT manual, premium/marketing policies, and the operational model for the issuance of securities through registered issuers. Obtain receipt and respond to all SFC information requirements before public launch.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
SFC application form and business plan
Platform technology and cybersecurity documentation
AML/CFT manual and UIAF registration plan
Escrow arrangement description and executing agreement
Template offering and subscription agreements for issuers and investors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SFC requests additional information, convene a technical response within the legal term to supplement the dossier; an unfavourable decision may be appealed via recurso de reposición before the same authority and in subsidio before the government under the Código de Procedimiento Administrativo.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal operation, civil defence and occupational clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Local / Secretaría de Gobierno and Cuerpo de Bomberos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the municipal use-of-land certificate (concepto de uso de suelo) and business operation license (registro de actividad) for the corporate office. Submit the premises for fire-safety inspection and receive the bomberos certificate. Adopt the SGSST (Occupational Health and Safety Management System), enrol the legal representative and employees with an ARL, and place the policy documents at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease agreement or property title for registered office
Layout plan or architectural schematics
Fire-safety inspection form
SG-SST policy and procedural manuals
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal office requires structural adjustments or the fire certificate is denied, correct the deficiencies in the inspection report, re-inspect the premises, and appeal administrative orders through the local Alcaldía according to Ley 1437 de 2011.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) for the crowdfunding platform licence; Cámara de Comercio and Alcaldía Local for the operation of the registered office.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorización de funcionamiento de Plataforma de Financiamiento Colaborativo (equity crowdfunding) under Decreto 1357 de 2018; municipal Licencia de Funcionamiento and Certificado de Seguridad de Bomberos.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and municipal environmental authority (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente for Bogotá D.C.)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — digital office services; no full EIA required for software-intermediation operations, but a domestic wastewater discharge permit may be required by the local water and sewerage utility for the physical office.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Inapplicable to crowdfunding data processing: no industrial effluent, VOCs or point-source emissions. Office domestic sewage must meet municipal sewer discharge limits under Resolución 2115 de 2007; discarded IT equipment is managed under Ley 1672 de 2013 and the extended producer responsibility resolutions on waste electrical and electronic equipment.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety: mandatory inspection and fire clearance from the local Cuerpo de Bomberos, including functioning extinguishers, emergency exits, fire-alarm systems and an emergency plan. Civil/structural: use-of-land and structural load certificate from the local planning authority. Occupational: enrolment in a recognized ARL and implementation of SG-SST covering ergonomics, psychosocial risk, and business-continuity for continuous digital platform operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official portal: www.dian.gov.co; virtual taxpayer office (Oficina Virtual) for RUT/NIT administration: muisca.dian.gov.co; electronic invoice validation and consultation environment: cfe.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Colombian S.A.S.: (1) incorporate before the Cámara de Comercio and file the digital mercantile registration; (2) apply for the RUT (Registro Único Tributario) and the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the DIAN Oficina Virtual or a physical service point, authenticating the legal representative's identity and contact data; (3) upon issuance, the RUT/NIT confers the status of IVA-responsible party, electronic invoicing subject, potential withholding agent, and foreign-trade operator. For a non-resident foreign shareholder or a foreign enterprise without a Colombian branch, a NIT may be obtained through a Colombian fiscal representative by filing the RUT with apostilled constitutional documents, board resolution appointing the representative, and a local notification address; no minimum capital applies to the S.A.S. All registrations are free of charge and the RUT/NIT is typically issued within one business day after incorporation records are integrated.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: the S.A.S. is a juridical person and Colombian tax resident assessed separately from its shareholders; there is no pass-through eligibility. The company is taxed on world-wide income, and non-resident shareholders are taxed only at source, including statutory withholding on distributed dividends. The S.A.S. is simultaneously an IVA-responsible party for consumption tax purposes and a withholding agent when statutory thresholds are met.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a check-the-box entity classification regime; an S.A.S. is mandatorily taxed as a corporation. Available statutory elections include: (i) opt-in to the simple combined taxation regime 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' (SIMPLES) for qualifying small businesses (Arts. 903 et seq. E.T.); (ii) accelerated depreciation and elective 1-3 year expensing of productive fixed asset investments (Art. 104 E.T.); (iii) the exporter's election to obtain periodic refund or offset of VAT input credits under Art. 855 E.T.; and (iv) compliance with the domestic anti-hybrid and BEPS Action 2 rules, which disallow deduction/double-deduction mismatches without leaving taxpayer-beneficial hybrid elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA — Impuesto sobre las Ventas (national value added tax) administered by DIAN; applies to the sale of goods, provision of services, sale and import of intangibles, and gambling operations in the Colombian territory. Municipal ICA and other local levies are separate and outside the VAT system.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP — No economic turnover threshold for juridical persons: the S.A.S. must register as an IVA-responsible party from its first taxable act regardless of revenue (Art. 437 E.T.). Only natural persons may qualify for the simplified non-responsible regime where gross annual income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 165 million for FY2024) and the remaining statutory conditions are met; this regime is not available to an S.A.S.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All IVA-responsible taxpayers must issue electronic invoices (Factura Electrónica de Venta - FEV) through DIAN-authorized technology providers or DIAN's free platform. The FEV is transmitted in real time to DIAN's web-service API using X.509 digital signature; DIAN validates the document and returns a unique traceability code, 'CUFE' for ordinary invoices or 'CUDS' for export operations, which is embedded as a QR code on the printable representation. No invoice is fiscally valid until DIAN acceptance is obtained; batch or offline issuance is limited to narrow statutory exceptions, and credit/debit notes and 'documento soporte' records are equally subject to electronic validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (exclusion) applies under Art. 481 E.T. to: (i) goods physically exported from Colombia under a valid customs export declaration; and (ii) services rendered in Colombia to non-resident customers which are used exclusively outside Colombia, at arm's length consideration, with proceeds repatriated under foreign-exchange regulations. For the equity-crowdfunding S.A.S., platform fees invoiced to non-resident issuers/investors qualify for 0% only when the service is contractually and effectively consumed abroad (foreign platform users, foreign servers, foreign contractual counterparties); fees charged to Colombian residents generally attract 19% IVA unless a specific statutory exemption, such as the financial-services exemption under Art. 476(4) E.T. where the operator is subject to financial supervision, is available. Exporters may further claim refunds of VAT embedded in export-related purchases under the Art. 855 E.T. procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export invoice (FEV with CUDS code) validated by DIAN evidencing the 0% rate
Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación - DEX) where physical goods are part of the transaction
Signed service agreement with the non-resident customer specifying scope, place of use, and market consideration
Inward remittance certificate and bank statement evidencing payment in foreign currency
Declaración de Cambio (foreign exchange declaration, export category, Form No. 5) filed with the authorized foreign-exchange intermediary
Substantiating records of exclusive foreign use (platform access logs, IP geolocation, client written attestation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN's assessment power expires after the statutory 5-year prescription period. Where the export tests are not met, the 0% rate is disregarded and 19% IVA is assessed on the gross consideration, plus monthly default interest under Art. 635 E.T. The 'sanción por inexactitud' under Art. 648 E.T. is imposed at 100% of the understated VAT; deliberate falsification of export documentation triggers criminal liability under Law 1762/2015, including imprisonment. VAT refunds previously obtained under Art. 855 E.T. on export inputs are clawed back with interest and the underlying input credits are disallowed; repeated improper zero-rating may result in suspension from DIAN's electronic invoicing and refund programs and disqualification of the legal representative.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) and Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (regulatory oversight), with exchange control administered under Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a floating exchange rate and full convertibility for current-account operations. Capital-account inflows, including foreign direct investment and equity contributions from crowdfunding investors, are subject to registration with Banco de la República and must be channelled through an authorised foreign-exchange intermediary (closer 'mercado de cambios con intermediario'). Profit and dividend remittances are freely permitted when the original foreign investment has been duly registered and Colombian income tax obligations have been satisfied; no additional withholding tax is levied solely for remittance, but a fiscal certificate from DIAN and the relevant Banco de la República registration (Formulario 2 for dividends) are required. Practical hurdles include mandatory intermediation, strict documentary time windows, source-of-funds verification, and the need for local representation for tax and FX filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia does not impose a universal percentage surrender obligation for all exporters. Exporters of goods and services must 'reintegrate' (repatriate) the foreign-currency proceeds into Colombia through the regulated foreign-exchange market within six (6) months from the date of exportation or delivery of the service, except for exports listed in exception clauses (e.g., energy, coal, coffee) that carry special conversion rules. The equity-crowdfunding portal's service fees on foreign platforms are service-export proceeds and are subject to the six-month repatriation term; they may be held in a foreign-currency deposit account in a local bank if prior authorisation is obtained. During the current regime, there is no mandatory conversion of export proceeds into COP; however, the proceeds must appear in the exporter's bank records and in the corresponding foreign-exchange declaration.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Colombian law does not recognise the EU/UK-style e-money institution (EMI) licence. A non-resident fintech or EMI cannot directly open settlement or operating accounts with Colombian banks or the national clearing/correspondent network unless separately regulated. Feasibility is rated Medium only where the foreign EMI partners with a Colombian licensed commercial bank, acts as a registered payment service provider under Superintendencia Financiera, and signs a formal agent/service agreement; otherwise, the operation is considered unauthorised money transmission and will be blocked by Colombia's banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance is generally mandatory for high-risk corporate accounts, including equity crowdfunding platforms. The Colombian AML/KYC framework (Circular Básica Jurídica 29/2014 and SFC regulations) imposes face-to-face verification, or an expressly authorised digital identity verification with a qualified biometric and video interview, for clients designated high risk. In practice, tier-1 banks require that the SAS legal representatives, ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), and compliance officer attend a physical onboarding interview, sign the banking agreements in the bank's branch (or via notarial power of attorney), and present original corporate documents. Remote-only onboarding is not available for a first relationship with an ISIC 6499 regulated portal.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk sector trigger: regulated equity crowdfunding/peer-to-peer portal under ISIC 6499, presenting fractional transactions from numerous unrelated retail investors and simultaneous payout requests to multiple startups.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submission of the SFC crowdfunding authorisation or pending-licence evidence; transactional compliance manual (SARLAFT), AML/CFT policies with investor due-diligence procedures; certified corporate registry (Cámara de Comercio) showing ultimate beneficial ownership; audited financial statements; background checks on directors; source-of-funds declarations of initial capital investors; and contractual escrow agreements stating that client funds will be segregated in a licensed trust account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound-funds-flow red flag: recurring cross-border wire transfers to investee startups without clear commercial subjacent or overlapping investor money movements, raising concern of money laundering or unregistered securities distribution.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed investment agreements between the portal and each investee, corporate board resolutions authorising disbursements, investor subscription records, the portal's due-diligence file on each investment, bank statements from escrow showing the traceability of funds, and the annual foreign-exchange declarations (Declaración de Cambio) covering each operation. The dossier must also include the issuer's registration in the Colombian National Securities Registry when applicable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections to the SAS or its escrow must be routed via SWIFT MT103 through a Colombian authorised intermediary (CAM). The wire must be addressed to an account held with a licensed local commercial bank and must include the foreign-investment concept code '310' (Principal of Foreign Direct Investment) or the specific code prescribed by Banco de la República for capital contributions made through equity crowdfunding. The sender and beneficiary must be identified with their full legal names, tax identification number (NIT if local, or foreign document), and the reason for payment referencing the registered Foreign Investment Application Form (Formulario 1). Prior to first receiving any foreign equity funds, the SAS must register the external investment with Banco de la República. The bank will apply enhanced KYC and may request the escrow agreement and SFC licence before accepting the inbound transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements from the platform to investee start-up business are cleared through (i) SWIFT MT103 for cross-border wires to foreign beneficiaries and (ii) the local CUD (Cuenta Única del Sistema de Pagos) or ACH-ACH Colombia for domestic disbursements. Given that ISIC 6499 is an equity crowdfunding intermediary and not an import/export goods trader, traditional commercial letters of credit are not the standard instrument; funds are released to investee companies by direct wire after validation of disbursement triggers, using the appropriate FX concept code for investment abroad or 'disbursement from escrow'. If a particular investee requires equipment imports, a commercial LC may be issued through a Colombian bank, but such LC issuance will be subject to the underlying import declaration and the relevant Banco de la República indirect forex registration. All outbound equity transfers must be accompanied by the investment agreements and the related annual Foreign Exchange Declaration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward (Forward de Reintegro) with authorised Colombian commercial banks under the regulated foreign-exchange market, used to hedge USD/COP repatriation risk.
FX Currency Swap (Swap de Tasa de Cambio) executed through a Colombian authorised CAM or an international bank with a domestic branch or correspondent approval.

Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) contracted offshore for hedging COP exposure; permissible in practice for centralised treasuries when the counterparty is an international bank, provided the operation is not used to bypass mandatory Colombian FX registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registration Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by March 31 (renewal window opens January 2 of the calendar year following the fiscal year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a daily penalty of approximately 5% per month of the renewal tariff, a suspension of the commercial registration, and the inability to obtain a certificate of good standing; prolonged non-payment may result in administrative cancellation of the registry entry and dissolution of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements and Management Report Deposit (Estados Financieros, Informe de Gestión, and Dictamen del Revisor Fiscal if mandatory)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval; shareholders must approve by March 31 for the immediately preceding fiscal year, so deposit by April 30
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to deposit the approved financial statements prevents the issuance of good-standing certificates, imposes monetary penalties by the Superintendencia de Sociedades, and blocks the commercial registration renewal process.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Registry Confirmation (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales – RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during August–September of the following fiscal year, according to the taxpayer's NIT last-digit calendar; updates must be filed within 30 calendar days after any relevant shareholding or control transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late, incomplete, or false RUB filings carry monetary sanctions of up to COP 300 million (approximately USD 75,000), restrict the issuance of tax clearance certificates, and may trigger liability for the legal representative under the Colombian AML/CFT regime.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Regulatory Compliance Report for Equity Crowdfunding Portal (Reporte de Cumplimiento and Financial Statements to SFC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the SFC instruction calendar, typically within four months after the fiscal year-end for supervised crowdfunding intermediaries
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or inaccurate SFC reporting triggers monetary sanctions from the SFC, a mandatory remediation plan, and may result in suspension or revocation of the equity crowdfunding portal license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory Revisor Fiscal is mandatory for a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada when gross assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (COP 6.25 billion for 2025, approx. USD 1.5 million) or gross operating revenue exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (COP 3.75 billion, approx. USD 0.9 million); an SFC-issued crowdfunding portal license also requires an independent auditor regardless of asset/revenue thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Colombia (NIIF) under Decreto Único Reglamentario 2420 de 2015; SFC supervised entities apply the additional regulatory accounting and disclosure instructions in Circular Básica Contable – Circular Externa 100 de 1995.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All share transfers must be recorded in the shareholder register and certified by the legal representative at the annual shareholders' meeting; for the RUB, the S.A.S. must confirm the identity and percentage of every ultimate beneficial owner, including natural persons holding more than 5% directly or indirectly or otherwise exercising control, and any change resulting from a transfer must be submitted to DIAN within 30 calendar days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de Asamblea y Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 – USD 5,000 per year for an SFC-licensed equity crowdfunding S.A.S.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday exists for an S.A.S. operating an equity crowdfunding portal. Available preferential mechanisms: (i) an additional 100% deduction on qualifying software/ICT development investments (Art. 256 E.T.); (ii) accelerated depreciation on certified technology and telecommunications equipment; (iii) VAT exemption for exported software-related digital services; and (iv) deductibility of payroll-related taxes and family welfare contributions for qualifying new jobs. A 3% sectoral surcharge applies only to certain financial institutions, oil, mining and coal entities; a crowdfunding portal is normally outside that surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios for legal entities), filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA e-filing module; payment is generated as a combined tax reference using the NIT and paid via authorized banking channels.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; the tax year is the calendar year. Income tax advance payments are made through two semi-annual installments (approximately February and June of the taxable year). VAT and national stamp tax filings follow separate monthly or bimonthly calendars depending on DIAN classification.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For calendar-year S.A.S. entities, Form 110 is due within the annual DIAN filing calendar established by resolution for the year following the fiscal year-end. The closing date generally falls in the first half of May, approximately five months after December 31, with the exact due date determined by the final two digits of the NIT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income: all ordinary revenues derived from the equity crowdfunding platform, including listing fees, success fees, escrow administration charges, commission income, and any other Gross income received by the S.A.S. before VAT and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not report platform revenues on Form 110; the Colombian S.A.S. is the resident taxpayer and must report 100% of Colombian-source revenue on this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable income and exempt income (rentas no constitutivas de renta ni ganancia ocasional and rentas exentas): may include certain capital reimbursements or statutorily exempt ICT/software export income; must be supported by the relevant E.T. provision.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty-protected dividend income of a foreign shareholder is not an exempt item in the S.A.S. return; exemptions are claimed only by the Colombian entity that generated the underlying income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and operating expenses: platform development, cloud hosting, legal services, marketing, personnel, depreciation, and amortization. Cross-border payments must satisfy WHT obligations and, where applicable, transfer pricing documentation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions for payments to affiliated foreign service providers require proof of actual service, economic substance, and correct withholding at statutory or treaty rate; otherwise DIAN will reject the expense.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating income (renta líquida ordinaria) before loss compensation: gross income less deductible costs, expenses, and asset impairment allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This is a computation line only; the foreign shareholder does not file any Colombian return based on this amount, but its dividend WHT entitlement depends on the profit having been taxed at the entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses applied from prior years: losses may be offset against ordinary taxable income for up to 12 taxable years, with a mandatory inflation adjustment if losses remain unused after the first five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss compensation belongs strictly to the S.A.S. and cannot be allocated, surrendered, or credited to non-resident shareholders or any foreign head office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net income (renta líquida gravable): the tax base resulting after loss compensation, subject to the 35% corporate income tax rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This base is used exclusively for the Colombian S.A.S. income tax; the non-resident shareholder is taxed separately at the moment of dividend distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: General income tax charge: taxable net income multiplied by the 35% statutory rate, prior to credits and prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The S.A.S. pays this tax on its entire Colombian tax base; the foreign shareholder's 10% dividend WHT is an additional, separate tax at distribution level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits, withholdings, and prepayments: Colombian withholding certificates, foreign tax credits, VAT-related tax credits where permitted, and income tax advance installments already paid.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only the Colombian S.A.S. may credit within the S.A.S. return; a foreign shareholder must use the tax treaty mechanism separately to reduce its dividend or interest WHT.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final tax payable or balance in favor: gross tax less credits and prepayments; if positive, payment must be made by the statutory deadline; if negative, a refund claim may be requested electronically.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders are not entitled to claim the S.A.S. balance in favor; their Colombian taxation is normally concluded via payment of WHT by the payer.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late voluntary filing: 5% of the income tax payable per month or fraction of a month of delay, capped at 100% of the tax (Art. 641 E.T.), with a minimum penalty scaled to the UVT. If DIAN issues an official demand before filing, the late-filing penalty increases and the return may be declared a failure. Late payment triggers moratorial default interest (Art. 635 E.T.). Material understatement or omission of income is sanctioned as inexactness up to 100% of the tax difference found by DIAN (Art. 647 E.T.), plus criminal liability if fraud is proven.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory dividend withholding rate on distributions to non-resident shareholders and foreign companies when dividends are paid out of profits already subject to the 35% corporate income tax (Art. 408-1 E.T.). Distributions from untaxed accounting profits are subject to a 35% withholding at the time of distribution. Resident individual shareholders pay a progressive surtax on dividend income above 300 UVT; however, the cross-border rate for the crowdfunding portal foreign investors is the 10% rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Colombia Double Taxation Agreement (DTA), the non-resident shareholder must deliver to the Colombian payer, before payment is made: (i) a valid Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority, apostilled and translated into Spanish; (ii) a certificate of beneficial ownership confirming that the shareholder, not an intermediary, owns the shares; and (iii) any ownership/activity information required to satisfy the treaty's limitation-on-benefits or substance clause. The Colombian S.A.S. then applies the reduced treaty WHT directly if the treaty permits source-state taxation. If the full 10% or 35% WHT was over-deducted, the foreign shareholder may file a refund request (devolución) with DIAN through the official e-portal within the applicable statute of limitations, attaching the TRC, the withholding certificate, and treaty position papers. DIAN has approximately one year to adjudicate, and the burden of proving residence and substance rests solely on the claimant.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory WHT is 15% on cross-border interest payments to foreign beneficiaries (Art. 408 E.T.); qualifying external banking credit registered with the Colombian Central Bank may access reduced rates, and DTA rates generally range from 5% to 12%. Royalties: statutory WHT is 15% for industrial property royalties and know-how, with a 10% rate for qualifying technical services (Art. 408 E.T.); Andean Community Decision 578 and Colombia's DTAs may reduce royalty rates to 5%–10%. Payments routed to blacklisted tax-haven jurisdictions are subject to additional scrutiny under Art. 260-7 E.T. and may be disallowed as deductions in full.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File, Master File, and the annual transfer pricing information returns (individual and consolidated e-forms designated by DIAN) are triggered when the S.A.S. carries out cross-border transactions with related parties and, in the preceding year, had either gross income or gross assets exceeding 100,000 UVT. For 2025, 100,000 UVT is approximately COP 5.1 billion (about USD 1.2 million). Transactions with entities resident in tax havens trigger documentation regardless of the monetary threshold, and a separate domestic related-party regime applies to transactions with Colombian related parties above 60,000 UVT.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia has not enacted a UAE-style Economic Substance Regulation regime, but equivalent substance requirements operate through: (i) the general anti-abuse rule under Art. 869 E.T., which authorizes DIAN to recharacterize transactions lacking genuine business purpose; (ii) the substance-over-form doctrine and legal personality disregard under Art. 42 of Law 1258/2008 for S.A.S. entities used for fraud or evasion; and (iii) the licensing and ongoing substance obligations imposed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia on regulated crowdfunding platforms under Decreto 1357/2018, including the need for physical presence, qualified staff, governance, capital, and auditable operational records in Colombia. A crowdfunding portal styled as a mere invoice conduit or mailbox company will fail license review and be challenged by DIAN.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Omitting or understating platform success fees, listing commissions, escrow interchange income, or investor administration charges in Form 110; issuing false electronic invoices; maintaining undisclosed foreign bank accounts in the name of related shareholders; or intentionally failing to file the income tax return after the first year of operation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Additional tax assessment with moratorial interest; inexactness penalty up to 100% of the tax difference (Art. 647 E.T.); late-filing penalty of 5% per month capped at 100% of the tax (Art. 641 E.T.); criminal tax fraud charges under Art. 434A of the Código Penal carrying prison from 48 to 108 months and a fine of up to 100% of the assessed evaded amount; and asset seizure to secure collection.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and statutory auditor who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable with the company for the unpaid taxes (Art. 794 E.T.). Where fraud is proven, the DIAN criminal referral triggers personal criminal prosecution of the directors, freezing of personal bank accounts, travel restrictions while the process is pending, and, upon conviction, imprisonment. Piercing of the corporate veil under Art. 42 of Law 1258/2008 renders shareholders' personal assets liable for investor restitution as well as tax debts.
